finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.sink: Reading the password from the 'secret' file
finding.trigger: If the 'secret' file contains malicious content, it could be executed as a command
finding.assumptions: The 'secret' file is expected to contain only the password, but if it contains any command or script, it could be executed

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.untrusted_source: The password read from the 'secret' file
finding.sink: Using the password in the SMTP authentication
finding.trigger: If the password contains any command or script, it could be executed
finding.assumptions: The password is expected to be plain text, but if it contains any command or script, it could be executed

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.sink: Using the email sender address in the SMTP authentication
finding.trigger: If the email sender address contains any command or script, it could be executed
finding.assumptions: The email sender address is expected to be plain text, but if it contains any command or script, it could be executed

finding.trigger: If the email recipient address contains any command or script, it could be executed
finding.assumptions: The email recipient address is expected to be plain text, but if it contains any command or script, it could be executed
